headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain 's difficult Ligue 1 start continued as early-season pace-setters AS Monaco won 2-1 at Parc des Princes.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG upset by Monaco to extend winless start

headlines.description: Ferran Torres scored the only goal of the game as Paris Saint-Germain earned their first Ligue 1 win of the season with a 1-0 victory at Brest.
headlines.shortLinkText: Torres strikes again to earn PSG first Ligue 1 win

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain closed out a tense 2-1 win over Le Classique rivals Marseille, who finished with 10 men at Stade Velodrome.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG down Marseille, Weah sent off in Le Classique
